detail:
Full summary: Brainstorming session: dashboard scale redesign for projects with 1000s of decisions/entries. Explored code + live UI, confirmed structural scale problems, proposed 3 approaches; awaiting user pick (B recommended).
Decisions: Chose to require a server-side query layer (pagination, scope/type/time filters, aggregation endpoints) as the foundation of any dashboard scale redesign over pure client-side fixes — no frontend idiom survives shipping 5k full records per poll tick.; Recommended scale-native redesign of timeline/graph/lists (canvas density timeline, aggregated meta-graph + ego-network explorer capped ~200 nodes, server-windowed virtual lists, new Health panel, scope as first-class drill-down) over (a) conservative retrofit of vis-timeline/cytoscape which both lack aggregation modes and would stay mediocre, and (b) full framework rewrite which touches all 7 tabs to fix 3 and adds a build toolchain to a zero-config npm package. Not yet user-approved — brainstorming in progress, design doc not written.
Findings: Dashboard API ships full datasets with no pagination/filtering/aggregation: /api/blackboard, /api/decisions, /api/graph in src/dashboard/api-routes.ts return everything; frontend polls and refetches the entire active-tab dataset every tick (app.js refreshData).; Graph Visual view renders ALL entities+relations through cytoscape cose force layout — already an unreadable hairball at 425 entities in this repo; superlinear layout cost makes 5k nodes freeze. buildGraphElements (app.js:2823) has no cap or clustering.; Decisions Timeline (vis-timeline, one stacked DOM item per decision, app.js initTimeline) is already a wall of overlapping boxes at 203 decisions; vis-timeline has no aggregation mode so it cannot scale to 1000s.; User requirements captured: all four jobs matter at scale (recent-activity orientation, decision archaeology, structure/hotspots, health/hygiene monitoring); design envelope ~5k records per store; no hard tech-stack constraint — pick on UX/perf merits.; Playwright MCP server added to project-local config (npx @playwright/mcp@latest --browser chrome --headless) for browser-driven UI development; MCP screenshots default into repo root — untracked .playwright-mcp/ dir and stray *.jpeg files created this session.
summary: Brainstorming session: dashboard scale redesign for projects with 1000s of decisions/entries. Explored code + live UI, confirmed structural scale problems, proposed 3 approaches; awaiting user pick…
